characters.name: Allison
characters.clueEn: She was on a bed. She was alone.

characters.name: Hudson
characters.clueEn: There was a man sitting in a chair exactly two rows north of him.
characters.clueZh: 在他正北方两行处，有一个男人坐在椅子上。

characters.name: Vallie
characters.clueEn: The Victim. She was alone with the murderer.
characters.clueZh: 被害者。和凶手单独在一起。

generalClues.text: 正好有一个区域是空的。
generalClues.textEn: There was exactly one empty area.
